title: Voice accordion — compact actionables & impact estimates (Nov 2026)
summary: Compact synthesis of the last four weeks of cross-channel customer signals focused on inference latency regressions, KV cache behavior, and UX asks. Prioritized micro-actions with estimated impact and T-shirt effort for rapid implementation. Emphasis on low-risk patches and measurable telemetry fixes.
background: We ran a quick signal harvest (support tickets, AEs notes, usage logs, and postmortems) between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-05. Several mid-market customers surfaced recurring themes where overall experience drops when models with long prefix histories run concurrently with bursty traffic. This doc distills customer vignettes, clusters asks into compact themes, and proposes immediate actions + owners.
customer_vignettes: Enterprise retail customer: periodic latency spikes during nightly ingest causing 95th percentile latency breach; observed heavy prefix reuse across multiple sessions.
SaaS analytics startup: unpredictable token cost after switching to a higher-context model; asks for clearer cost-per-call visibility and per-route throttling controls.
Healthcare partner: strict privacy; requires Private deployment rollout checklist and assurance on KMS key rotation and audit logs for inference traces.
themes: Latency SLO regressions during bursty traffic
top_actionables: Add 'kv-cache-hit-rate' metric to per-route dashboard (owner: observability, impact: high, effort: small).
Introduce an opt-in per-route 'burst-mode' policy to reserve headroom for short lived spikes (owner: serving-runtime, impact: medium, effort: medium).
Quick UX: show estimated token cost in Console for each saved route and last 7-day avg (owner: console-and-rollouts, impact: high, effort: small).
Private: publish a one-page KMS rotation checklist and sample audit log view for customers on Private (owner: private-deployments, impact: high for regulated customers, effort: small).
impact_estimates_and_effort: kv-cache metric: reduces MTTI for ops triage by ~60% for repeated-prefix customers; effort: 2-3 engineer-days + 1 dashboarding day.
Burst-mode policy: expected to reduce 95p latency breaches by 20–30% in affected tenants; effort: 2 sprint tickets (backend + policy UI).
Token cost UX: reduces billing support tickets and confused users; quick win for PLG; effort: 3-4 engineer-days + design review.
quickpatch_candidates: Server-side: small change to prefer warmed KV shards for frequent tenant prefixes (can be gated behind a rollout flag).
Console: include a lightweight 'cost estimate' tooltip powered by recent usage sample (no billing schema change).
Docs: Private deployment runbook appendix for KMS/HSM rotation with example audit entries.
risks_and_unknowns: KV decisions may increase memory footprint on some Dedicated pools — need sandbox validation.
Burst-mode policy tuning could unintentionally favor long-running flows; require safety net and rollback policy.
Cost estimates based on short windows may mislead high-variance workloads — include clear caveat in UI.
measurement_plan: Pre/post comparison on 95p latency for top-10 affected tenants (7 days baseline).
Monitor support ticket volume and billing disputes related to token cost for routes where cost-UX is enabled (30-day window).
KV hit rate increase and cache eviction rate post-change; correlate with cost per-token.
recommended_next_steps: (0) Triage owners to accept actionables in weekly CS->ENG sync (Nov 17).
(1) Observatory: add kv-cache-hit-rate metric and surface on route dashboard (sprint 1).
(2) Serving-runtime: prototype burst-mode policy in internal dev pool, evaluate memory tradeoffs (sprint 2).
(3) Console: ship cost estimator tooltip behind feature flag and measure support delta (sprint 1).
(4) Private: publish KMS rotation appendix and schedule customer walkthroughs for 2 top regulated accounts (ASAP).
open_questions: What is acceptable memory increase for Dedicated pools before we require a pricing flag?
Do customers prefer a per-route cost cap or a soft throttle notification?
Can we instrument longer-term KV lifecycle signals without significant overhead?
notes_to_self: Use this doc as the seed for a short CS->Eng proposal (one-pager) and link the kv-cache metric RFC once draft is ready. Capture customer quotes as anonymized snippets for the proposal.
export_instructions: This file is a working artifact. After triage mark status=in_review and attach JIRA tickets for each accepted action. Add final owners to each actionable before moving to final.
